Source: local ProjectX repository, tools/app-state at commit 965c344217a22d408aa97d7818d9226828d29ff4. Core, native adapters, CLI, format and existing tests copied in full. Product worker adapted from tools/app-state/product/Worker.m. Service orchestration adapted from PXAppStateService.m and process runner from PXKeychainOneShotExecution.m. Original PX names retained for traceability. TrollVNC additions: standalone runtime paths, public services, validated socket request mapping and JSON result normalization. No runtime dependency on ProjectX, UIKit or its daemon/profile system. Historical docs describe ProjectX experiments, not TrollVNC verification. The source repository license is retained in LICENSE.

Port fixes include partial deletion reporting, unknown archive-operation flags, strict system-scope rejection, metadata patch preservation and bounded IDFV helper supervision/recovery. See docs/VALIDATION.md for evidence and device acceptance limits.

TVASAppLifecycle is a TrollVNC addition using the existing AppManagement exact-process identity pattern, expanded to include bundled extension processes. It does not depend on the RFB AppManagement transport. Its facade deadline and process-wide unknown fence are implemented in TVAppStateServices.
